The stars have aligned and i have fixed this bug by adding one `ERR_PRINT` that would obviously print nothing. I have no explanation for this, i cannot replicate this anymore.

I could replicate it again! For no apparent reason, my compilation started to have this issue *again*. I couldn't fix it by adding any lines anymore, recompiling all the stuff didn't help, reloading PC didn't help too (gotta be careful you know)...

What helped is...
```
scons platform=windows target=release_debug optimize=none
```

Disabling optimization at all. Honestly, it's sad to miss speed optimization, but MSVC seems to provide some kind of broken optimization. Better safe than sorry. Btw i didn't notice that much of a negative impact, but still sad to have it disabled.
Reopening because this may well be a valid issue (if not a tool chain issue).
